about: The categories of the Chronicle of Aoaz (docs/specs/07_interface/04_chronicle_codex.md section 2), in the order the window lists them. n is the category number used in entry ids (n x 100 + position; realms use the ids of realm_ids.json). The spec's eleven categories, plus deep_past (the six fallen realms, owner decision K64 of 25 October 2026) and realms (every realm's roots and sign, owner decision K67 of 25 October 2026), both added by lane W9. sigil and plate are image subjects (tools/content/art/chronicle-jobs.mjs).

categories.name: The Order of Being
categories.sigil: a ring of seven faint stars
categories.plate: stars over a black sea with one pale band of light across the sky

categories.name: The Fallen Realms
categories.sigil: a broken stone arch half sunk in water
categories.plate: the stumps of ancient walls and broken pillars rising from a grey sea at low tide under an overcast sky

categories.name: The First Age
categories.sigil: an upright spear with a long pennant
categories.plate: ancient banners on long poles on a windswept hill under a wide sky

categories.name: The Second Age
categories.plate: rebuilt city walls of pale stone in grey rain, wreaths of mourning laid along them

categories.name: The Third Age
categories.sigil: a pale lantern hanging from a short chain
categories.plate: a grey occupied city at dusk under a row of pale cold lanterns

categories.name: The Fourth Age
categories.sigil: a slender tower on the shore of still water
categories.plate: the towers of a great lake city above calm water in morning light

categories.name: The End of the Age
categories.sigil: five banners converging on one point
categories.plate: smoke rising over a crossroads where ragged war banners meet under a red evening sky

categories.name: Figures
categories.sigil: a quill pen crossed over an open book
categories.plate: an empty scriptorium desk with an open book, a quill and one lit oil lamp

categories.name: Peoples
categories.sigil: a circle of four joined hands
categories.plate: a crowded market square of many folk seen from high above, small and distant

categories.name: Lands and Places
categories.sigil: a compass rose without any letters
categories.plate: mountains, sea and forest folding into each other at dusk

categories.name: Roots and Signs
categories.sigil: a small shield on a tree with deep roots
categories.plate: a long stone hall hung with many old embroidered banners without lettering, fading into the dark

categories.name: Realms and Orders
categories.sigil: a wax seal on a ribbon
categories.plate: a long dark table covered with wax seals, ribbons and rolled charters

categories.name: Relics and Wonders
categories.plate: an open dark velvet case with empty hollows of different shapes
